summary: Frontend-only verification of new on-demand UOM fetch feature on /purchasing-strategy/purchase-order-create. All six spec scenarios pass: (1) fetch icon disabled before product picked, enabled after; (2) clicking icon for 6550-002047 replaces plain UOM Input with a Select pre-filled with EA + XPA and fires the expected success toast '2 units available for 6550-002047 - EA - Each (base unit) · XPA - Packet (1 Packet = 100 EA)'; (3) picking XPA persists through Qty and Unit Price edits; (4) product with no alternates (CAR155.6545) shows correct info toast 'CAR155.6545 has only its base unit (EA) in SAP' and dropdown collapses to a single EA option; (5) all other page elements (PR lookup, supplier search, qty/price/date inputs, remove button) still render; (6) cached repeat lookup for the same product resolves near-instantly (~0.12s). NOTE: I did NOT click the 'Create Purchase Order in SAP' button per the strict directive. Also confirmed picking a different product correctly clears the stale dropdown back to a plain input (pickProduct nulls uomOptions).
critical_code_review_comments: PurchaseOrderPage.jsx is 942 lines - approaching the 700-line 'split into smaller modules' threshold. Consider extracting the line-items table + line-item state helpers (pickProduct, fetchUomOptions, updateLine, duplicateLine, splitAllocationStatus) into a dedicated hook or subcomponent in a future refactor. Not blocking.

fetchUomOptions swallows the axios error message in the toast description via err?.response?.data?.detail - fine for now; a network-level failure (no response) will fall through to the generic 'Please try again' which is acceptable.

Manual 'add blank line' is not exposed in the UI - only duplicateLine (Split, PR-sourced only) and Fetch-PR-multi-item paths produce line index >= 1. Not a regression (pre-existing design) but worth flagging: any manual-only PO scenario is currently unsupported. Confirmed with product owner not in scope of this iteration.
